reviews: Security and privacy review of cache contents and redaction guarantees
Validation correctness review of dependency coverage, invalidation, and fail-toward-run behavior

findings.summary: Cache entries store only validator names, pass/fail booleans, error counts, SHA-256 hex digests, and ISO timestamps. buildEntry() (validation-cache.cjs:298-309) and buildSuiteEntry() (318-333) produce no file contents, error messages, provider prompts/responses, or credentials. The validate-speed-validation-cache.cjs validator (lines 150-170) mechanically scans for JWT, API key, and credential patterns in the entry structure.

The .projectops/validation-cache/ directory is not in .gitignore (adding it would require writing outside the worker's grant). Resolved in code: gitState() filters the cache directory from porcelain output so the suite fast path works, and walkDir() skips 'validation-cache' so hashing .projectops as a declared input does not cascade-invalidate. A manual .gitignore entry is cosmetically desirable but not mechanically required.

walkDir() (validation-cache.cjs:75-88) excludes node_modules, .git, target, and validation-cache directories from hashing. hashFile() uses readFileSync and sha256 — no external network call, no data exfiltration path. Cache write failures are silently caught (line 277) — a write failure is a performance loss, not a correctness or security loss.

All fail-toward-run rules verified: empty inputPaths produce coverage 'none' (line 143), missing/unreadable inputs produce coverage 'partial' (lines 155-159), checkValidatorCache rejects non-full coverage (line 391), corrupt entries return null from readEntry (lines 244-265), wrong schemaVersion returns null (line 249), expired entries return null (lines 399-400, 350-351), NaN age returns null. No path produces a cache hit when inputs are unknown or changed.

Full uncached validation (validate-all.cjs) is unmodified and remains the authoritative runner. The cached runner is an explicitly documented ALTERNATIVE (cached-runner.cjs header lines 7-8), not a replacement. Module list identity is enforced by validate-speed-validation-cache.cjs (lines 30-72) which mechanically extracts and compares the MODULES arrays from both files.

Cache deletion safety: clear() (validation-cache.cjs:487-495) removes the entire cache directory. readEntry() returns null when a file is absent, causing checkValidatorCache and checkSuiteCache to return null (miss), causing the validator to run. No correctness property depends on cache presence.

readEntry() was updated (prior run, now at validation-cache.cjs:244-265) to accept both per-validator and suite-level entries. Suite entries have kind:'suite', head, and results[] instead of passed/errorCount. Without this branch, the suite fast path (the primary <=2s target) would always miss because readEntry would reject every suite entry as corrupt. Confirmed resolved in current source.

walkDir() now skips the 'validation-cache' directory (validation-cache.cjs:83) preventing cascading cache invalidation when plan validators declare .projectops as an input. Without this, writing a cache entry would change the .projectops hash, invalidating all plan validators' cache keys in a self-defeating cycle. Confirmed resolved in current source.

Suite-level fast path requires two git commands (rev-parse HEAD, status --porcelain) plus one file read and key comparison — all local, sub-second operations. Per-validator cache avoids running unchanged validators when inputs are declared. The warm unchanged target (<=2s) is achievable by the suite fast path. The targeted source target (<=60s) is achievable by the per-validator cache when only a subset of inputs changed.

Input map declarations for broad-scan validators (e.g. validate-no-secrets scanning all of projectos/ and knowledge/) have coarse granularity: any file change under those trees invalidates the per-validator cache. This is correct (no false hits) but reduces cache effectiveness for partial changes. The suite fast path covers the warm-unchanged case regardless of per-validator granularity.

Node.js command execution was blocked by the permission system in this run. validate-no-secrets passed at exit code 0 in the prior run's evidence (session abc4dce, at 2026-09-04T08:46:47.200Z) with no speed/ or validator source changes between abc4dce and the current HEAD 3011be9 (only control-center files changed). The cache validator was verified by static trace through all 8 test sections. Mechanical re-execution by the owner or a permission-unblocked run remains recommended.
